strongest_result.claim: Decorated radical-tower monodromy H_q=Aff(F2^2,F2^q) semidirect S4 cannot occur for an actual complex plane Keller map when q>=2 and every generic branch meridian is T_(edge,r).
proof_chain: PF129 Euler budget forces a single branch component.
The natural quartic intermediate has entire étale locus V with 1<=chi(V)<=2.
Specified inertia fixes all sheets in fixed blocks, so residual ramification over V is zero.
The relative cover is universal étale with deck (C2)^q.
New low-Euler exact-volume lemma forces pi1(V) cyclic.
strongest_result.scope_boundary: Other inertia classes for the same abstract H_q, general binary affine groups, and q=1 are not excluded.

proof_cautions: Use the full component-selection form of HC4MYML0.
Normalized orbifold base change can split fibres; all resulting components are reduced.
Bad teardrops and unequal spindles cannot be uniformized by the asserted manifold cover; their fundamental groups are already cyclic.

mathieu_restrictions.remaining_mixed_pure_requirement: One entire charged side lies in the degree-12 Peter-Weyl component.
mathieu_restrictions.excluded_family: Both charged sides each have some component above degree 12; in particular no charged degree-12 projection.

mathieu_restrictions.remaining_mixed_pure_requirement: One entire charged side lies in the filtered sum of degrees 8 and 12.
mathieu_restrictions.excluded_family: Both charged sides each have some component above the degree-8/12 sector.
